title: VehicleChanged
description: The ERP created or edited a Vehicle of the Own fleet (Canonical Model event, version 1, E3). Published on the master-data events topic through the ERP's transactional outbox, in the transaction that saved the change, under a correlation ID created for the change. It carries the whole Vehicle and its Master-data revision, so the TMS replaces its copy and needs nothing more. Making a Vehicle inactive changes only its active flag; the TMS keeps its own availability apart from the copy (ADR 0014).

eventId.description: The event's own ID, a UUID.

id.description: The Vehicle ID both applications use, such as VEH-0001.

active.description: A Vehicle is never deleted, only made inactive.

revision.description: The Master-data revision: 1 as loaded from the seed file, raised by every edit. The TMS applies only a revision higher than the one it holds.
